items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: I played up there with Thomas up there, Marrero, we played for Spex.

ctx.x: Well, he's older than you anyhow. Huh? He's older than you anyway. Oh yeah, yeah. Definitely. He's much older man than you, huh? Well what about up the road, up by Gratner and McDonaville,

you ever play over there? Well we used to play up there a long time ago. We used to, I played up there with Thomas up there, Marrero, we played for Spex. Uh huh. A fellow by the name of Spex, he had a little nightclub up there. He used to go up there with Thomas and play up there. We used to go to, Thomas used to go to wrestling, and dabb all the way to Lockport.
Did he use the piano when you were with him? Yeah, he used to use George James. So he had good rhythm there, full rhythm, huh? Uh huh. That good full rhythm there. Yeah, yeah.
